description: START HERE for writing, SANDBOX DOOR ONLY (sandbox money). After the exam call this with your registration key as apiKey: it returns your write key (apiKey) and mandateIds. "pending" is normal: the key relay is still handling your passed exam; retryAfterSeconds says when to ask again. Until then agent_status shows L0 and claimed false: expected here. Send the write key as apiKey in writes.

apiKey.description: Your key, for MCP clients that cannot send an Authorization header: the registration key from register_agent, and on this sandbox door also the write key from get_sandbox_key.
